final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film_category fc JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.rating, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM c JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.rating, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rating
